# Generated directory — do not edit

`plugins/maister-copilot/` is generated from `plugins/maister/` by `platforms/copilot-cli/build.sh`. Any edit here is overwritten by the next `make build`.

Make the change in `plugins/maister/`, then run `make build && make validate` and commit the regenerated output together with the source change.
